title: REQ · Game config declares pixel-art, round-pixel and FIT scaling keys valid in Phaser 3.90
summary: buildGameConfig exposes pixelArt, roundPixels, antialias false, FIT, CENTER_BOTH and autoRound
description: Context: config.ts has render and scale blocks but no autoRound and the render block is inline. Desired: render settings in an exported constant and scale gains autoRound true so canvas CSS size stays on whole pixels. Expected: valid Phaser 3.90 GameConfig.
acceptance_criteria: Given buildGameConfig, When called with a div, Then render equals {pixelArt:true, roundPixels:true, antialias:false}
Given buildGameConfig, When called, Then scale includes mode FIT, autoCenter CENTER_BOTH and autoRound true

preserve: Existing config shape and scenes passthrough

technical_constraints: Keys must exist in Phaser 3.90 GameConfig typings
